# hash-wasm vendored runtime

- Version: 4.12.0
- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/hash-wasm/-/hash-wasm-4.12.0.tgz
- Upstream: https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

Only the five minified UMD modules needed by the Crypto file-hash worker are included. Each module embeds its WebAssembly binary, so the static app makes no runtime network request.
